name: run_all.sh
mathematical_scope: Shell regression orchestrator for two archived test packages and three named audit scripts.
input_and_guard_coverage: set -euo pipefail catches failing commands; no test-count validation, hash verification, timeout or package-version lock. Numpy import failure skips condition audit.
costs: Runs dependencies with unrestricted cumulative duration; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 applies only to the conditional condition audit.
test_evidence: unittest discovery may report success with zero tests. Final success text is broader than the actually enforced checks.
acceptance_boundary: Exit success means only the selected commands that ran exited zero; it is not exact source identity or mathematical acceptance.
findings: L4–5 permit empty discovery. L9–11 silently omit condition audit when numpy is missing/broken; L12 still says all checks passed.
